cohort_identity_status: PARTIALLY_RESOLVED: cross-registrations PRJCA039020 / CRA024916 / PRJDB36521 are verified as one Luo et al. BALF shotgun cohort; however, public run/BioSample-to-subject-to-group identity remains unresolved.
primary_estimand_validity: CONDITIONALLY VALID as a paper-level question, but not currently operationally estimable at accession level because no public key links runs/BioSamples to paper participants or CAP/severe labels. Severe group n=25 further limits any inferential claim.
major_blockers: No direct run/BioSample-to-subject-to-CAP/severe public or author-supplied key; all 233 public accessions have UNRESOLVED subject and published group.
Four excess public records beyond paper n=229 have no identified role or exclusion status; accession-order or count-based exclusions are not valid.
Severe pneumonia group n=25 is strongly imbalanced against CAP n=204; finite-sample inference and explicit effect-size planning are required.
Covariate timing, individual antibiotic exposure, sequencing batch, and negative controls are unresolved or absent.
major_confounders: Antibiotic exposure before BALF (uncertain but clinically important)
overadjustment_risks: PSI: likely a severity definition component; conditioning on it can erase the CAP/severe contrast being studied.
qSOFA: likely a severity definition component or acute downstream state; adjustment overcontrols and distorts the estimated effect.
Ventilation: mediator consequent to severity and/or treatment; adjustment may attenuate the contrast or introduce collider bias.
Initial treatment: mediator occurring after presentation/group assignment; adjustment likely overadjusts.
Laboratory variables: often outcome components or collateral, not baseline confounders; should not be used in maximal adjustment sets.
recommended_primary_model: Unadjusted Aitchison beta-diversity PERMANOVA for CAP versus severe, using exact finite-sample permutations suitable for unbalanced groups; report pseudo-F, R², effect size, and uncertainty, with PERMDISP mandatory. If verified pre-exposure covariate linkage becomes available, a separate minimally adjusted sensitivity model may condition only on age and sex. Do not include PSI, qSOFA, ventilation, treatment, or laboratory variables as covariates.
recommended_sensitivity_models: Age/sex-adjusted Aitchison PERMANOVA (maximum two covariates) after verifying overlap and missingness.
Selected pre-existing comorbidity-adjusted or stratified analysis if case counts permit; otherwise report comorbidity descriptively.
Stratified by pre-BALF antibiotic exposure timing once available.
Directly identify and remove the four extra public records only after traceable key resolution; no accession-order heuristic.
Leave-one-out or downsampled CAP comparison to assess influence of severe group outliers and severe group n=25.
Sensitivity excluding rare taxa or using alternative zero-handling after pre-registration.
permanova_recommendation: Use Aitchison distances on CLR-transformed or robust CLR data. Apply PERMANOVA with exact or constrained permutations that respect finite sample size, unbalanced groups, and any batch or sex structure. Report pseudo-F, R², p-value, and effect-size uncertainty. Do not interpret R² as large explained variance without supporting effect sizes. If PERMDISP is significant, interpret group difference as dispersion rather than location and consider alternative transforms.
permdisp_requirement: PERMDISP is mandatory alongside every PERMANOVA. If dispersion differs significantly, report that apparent group difference may be driven by variance/heteroscedasticity, not solely community location. Interpret accordingly and do not claim a location shift without evidence of homoscedasticity.

cross_cohort_role.A: FALSE/NOT SUPPORTED: this cohort cannot replicate a PRJNA1056765 four-diagnosis disease signature; the clinical grouping and design differ, and mapping is unresolved.
cross_cohort_role.B: TRUE/CONDITIONAL: if a prespecified CAP/severe clinical grouping is linked via a direct key and the analysis plan is frozen, it can independently test bounded lower-airway community variation; currently blocked by unresolved mapping.
cross_cohort_role.C: TRUE/WITHIN-COHORT: it may contribute comparable ecological estimands such as alpha diversity, Aitchison beta diversity, PERMANOVA R², and PERMDISP while preserving cohort-specific contrasts.
cross_cohort_role.D: FALSE/NOT SUPPORTED: CAP/severe, DR/DS-TB, and four-level diagnosis cannot be pooled as one disease effect; they are different diseases, study designs, and clinical contrasts.

conditions_before_pilot: Direct, auditable public or author-supplied key linking each run/BioSample to participant, inclusion/exclusion status, and CAP/severe label.
Resolve identity and role of the four excess public records without using accession order or group-count arithmetic.
Provide row-level clinical covariate dictionary with timing and missingness, including pre-BALF antibiotic exposure.
Pre-register analysis plan: distance metric, zero handling, permutations, effect sizes, differential abundance as exploratory only, multiple testing control, rare-taxon rules.
Resolve or explicitly state absence of sequencing batch and negative controls.
Obtain explicit user authorization for any raw-read download or bounded pilot.
fatal_flaws_if_any: No public run-to-subject-to-group key currently prevents any valid biological manifest, pilot, or CAP/severe contrast; all accessions have UNRESOLVED group labels.
Four excess public records are unidentifiable and unresolved, so the analyzed 229 cannot be reconstructed from public evidence.
reviewer_attack_points: 233 public accessions versus 229 paper patients: without a key, any CAP/severe contrast is non-identifiable and risk of technical replicates, controls, or excluded subjects is unresolved.
Severe group n=25 is underpowered for covariate adjustment and vulnerable to outliers; any adjusted model risks overfitting and cannot rescue unmeasured confounding.
Adjusting for PSI/qSOFA likely overcontrols because they define or are downstream of severity; ventilation and treatment are mediators and should not be conditioned on.
Antibiotic exposure is a major confounder but unavailable; observed community differences could be treatment effects, not disease severity.
PERMANOVA with unbalanced groups and unmodeled dispersion may yield false positives; PERMDISP and finite-sample permutations are essential.
Aitchison distances require careful zero handling and taxonomic resolution; rare taxa with severe n=25 are unstable, so differential abundance is exploratory only.
No negative controls or batch information means reagent contamination and technical variability cannot be separated from biological signal.
overall_verdict: SAFE_STOP at current evidence. The cohort-specific CAP/severe community question is conditionally valid as a future ecological analysis, but manifest freeze and bounded pilot cannot proceed until mapping and protocol are fully resolved and authorized. Any future analysis should be descriptive/exploratory with stringent finite-sample inference, dispersion diagnostics, and no pooling across disease cohorts.
